notes.title: Patch notes 2 + Deluxe Edition Now Available!
notes.notes:
Magratheus blesses you, Striver.

Thank you for answering the call and fulfilling your duty once more as the Striver, by ridding the land of Ire of the evil Gahars. We have been working hard to fix commonly raised bugs and issues that our brave Strivers have encountered.

We're happy to push through our second patch for the full game, fixing a range of issues with New Game+ and various bugs.
Read the full patch notes below:

[b][h3]Patch Notes - 29/05/2024:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue causing players to lose mouse control after exiting certain UI.
[*]Fixed a visual bug where dual handed weapons stay on the Strivers back after unequipping then. 
[*](NG+) Fixed an issue causing the Dare of Hardship to allow enemies to 1-Hit the player. 
[*] (NG+) Fixed an issue where the Dare of Insanity wasn't working correctly. 
[*] (NG+) Added a redundancy to recover save data if corrupted during NG+ (If save data is corrupted you will be reset to previous shrine)
[/list]
Alongside this we are also delighted to announce that we now have a Digital Deluxe edition of the game available which includes an artbook and a full soundtrack!

Find the link to the Digital Deluxe edition [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41198/Morbid_The_Lords_of_Ire_Digital_Deluxe_Edition/]here[/url].

If you encounter any other bugs on your journey through Ire, please leave your bug report on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2171560/discussions/0/4331977981785818130/?snr=2_9_100003_]dedicated reporting thread here[/url]. We are monitoring these issues and will continue to fix as many issues as we can.

And please continue to leave your thoughts and feedback in discussions and reviews, we’d love to hear what you think about the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41198/Morbid_The_Lords_of_Ire_Digital_Deluxe_Edition/

notes.title: Morbid: The Lords of Ire - Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Greetings, Striver! 

[h3][b]We're excited to announce that Morbid: The Lords of Ire is coming to Steam on May 23rd![/b]
[/h3]

In Morbid: The Lords of Ire, risk insanity in the gruesome slash-em-up with brutal combat and souls-like elements. Defeat the five Lords of Ire as you fight for your life across tortured landscapes, rending the evil Gahars of their flesh-bound forms.

You've defeated Morio, the Man-Eater in the realm of Rimehold. Here's what in store for you next in the stricken land of Ire - click below to watch the new Release Date trailer:

[url=https://youtu.be/cv1IfwVB72A][img] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609920/b35cff614212745a3df4006526ab691c4ee4deea.jpg[/img][/url]


If you haven't tried the demo yet be sure to play it now! ▶️ 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2171560/Morbid_The_Lords_of_Ire/

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes #1
notes.notes:
Greetings, Striver.

Magratheus blesses you with [b]a new range of fixes in our latest patch for the Morbid: The Lords of Ire Demo.[/b]

Read the full patch notes below:

[list]
[*] Improved sprinting feel
[*] Adjusted some of the buff items' duration times (more will come)
[*] Grom (miniboss) is bringing his A-game
[*] Vsync, and controller vibration sliders added in the setting menu
[*] Minor visual bugs fixed with equipped weapons
[*] Added controller vibration to finisher-attacks for all weapon classes
[*] Improved the combat feel of all weapon classes
[*] Balanced shroom effects on bosses
[*] Fixed "Esc" button on menu's
[*] Added very important paintings in the Hall of Redemption
[*] Lighting adjustments for Hall of Redemption
[*] Allowed for greater adjustability of the camera movement sensitivity on a controller
[*] Fixed a few stuck-spots in Rimehold
[*] Small tutorial tweaks
[*] Fixed a "speedrun" dash-hack
[*] Sprinting is now allowed while targeting (sprinting backwards will disable target for now)
[*] Balanced stamina behaviour for Blocking
[*] Balanced weapon swapping animation speeds
[*] Travelling no longer resets your XP Multiplier (we'll enable this for meditation as well asap)
[*] Small UI adjustments and fixes
[*] Potential crashes within Morbid Menagerie have been fixed
[/list]
